en: Vintage illustrated postcard with two main panels framed by flowers. The left panel shows a river scene at sunset, likely the Nile, with sailboats (feluccas), palm trees on the bank, and a distant cityscape with minarets. A lone figure in traditional dress stands by the water. The right panel shows a photograph or drawing of an ancient statue labeled as a wooden statue of a dignitary. Decorative flowers border the images. Handwritten numbers and a signature appear near the bottom.
